## Purpose

Describe the economic, numerical, editorial, or user-facing problem addressed by this change. Link the issue or model proposal when one exists.

## Public contracts affected

- [ ] Scores or validity status
- [ ] Targets, slacks, peers, weights, or diagnostics
- [ ] Dataset or provenance
- [ ] API, compatibility, or performance
- [ ] Visualization or reporting
- [ ] Package Documentation
- [ ] No public contract

## Evidence and validation

List defining sources, independent numerical checks, tests, benchmarks, strict Sphinx builds, and reproducible examples run for this change. For a new method, link its source-freeze protocol and explain why it is not only a renamed existing mechanism.

## Rights and credit

Identify every component changed and the applicable inbound terms. Software code uses DCO 1.1 sign-off and GPL-3.0-only (inbound = outbound). Original package Documentation prose uses CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0; its code examples remain GPL. Identify the origin and redistribution license of contributed data, figures, or substantial third-party material. State any requested scholarly acknowledgment that should be discussed before merge.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept the change focused and preserved unrelated work.
- [ ] I added or updated tests proportional to the affected contract.
- [ ] I kept code, equations, notation, examples, and result semantics aligned.
- [ ] I updated package Documentation at the appropriate level.
- [ ] I did not turn an unavailable or invalid result into a finite score.
- [ ] I am entitled to contribute every added dataset, figure, and substantial text passage.
- [ ] Every commit in this pull request has my `Signed-off-by` line under DCO 1.1; the component-specific license terms above still apply separately.
- [ ] I contribute original package Documentation prose under CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 and Documentation code under GPL-3.0-only, or this pull request contains neither.
- [ ] Every dataset has an origin declaration and proposed content-license mapping; I have not inferred permission from citation or storage in source, or this pull request contains no dataset content.
